sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 6 grams of fat. Saturated fat is 0.6 grams, supporting a cleaner fat profile. Omega 3 is 250 milligrams, supporting a more useful fat profile, but it is the smaller helper in this section. For legumes, fat usually matters less than fibre and protein.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 60.7 grams of carbs. Fibre is 17.4 grams, helping with digestion and steadier meals. Sugar is 10.7 grams, making sugar control harder, so that's a real downside for legumes. For legumes, fibre and protein make carbs better.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 19.3 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, making the protein useful for repair and maintenance, and it is still a strong secondary mark. For legumes, protein support is a big deal.

sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: strong all-round legume profile. Fibre, minerals, and useful protein all show up well enough to make it a very solid category food. Easy to use across lots of meals. Works in bowls, curries, salads, hummus, and snacks. Pretty filling and steady. Useful as a practical staple rather than just a niche health food.
